name: retrace
description: Capture how an AI-assisted task was done (decisions, prompts, mistakes, cheaper path) as a lesson skill, and teach it to people.

interface.longDescription: After an AI-assisted task, retrace captures the goal, the decisions and their rationale, the prompts that worked, mistakes and fixes, and how to do it cheaper next time, as a lesson skill. Anyone can then be taught how it was built: overview, step-by-step walkthrough with check questions, or a hands-on rebuild. Lessons stay on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Retrace what we just built and make a lesson
Teach me how we built the checkout flow
Quiz me on the spendsum lesson
